rules_story_title: Story: Secret Deals in the Tomb
rules_story_flavor: "In a cramped, damp burial crypt of a local magnate at the Wojsławice cemetery, there was an unbearable crowd. A decaying coffin served as a conference table, on which a map of Stary Majdan scribbled with charcoal on a shoebox card was laid out. Werewolves sneezed constantly from dust and mustiness, vampires complained of lack of air, ghosts lost their ectoplasmic fluffiness due to humidity and hung sadly under the ceiling lamenting the lack of LTE coverage, and Bardaks quietly unscrewed brass coffin handles trying to steal the Baron's wallet and his spare silver-plated teeth."
rules_story_para1: The Generals debated at midnight on how to approach the old man, who uses battery acid and expired dynamite in his arsenal instead of holy water. The atmosphere was thick with the stench of wet fur, ancient decay, and competitors' moonshine. The alliance was fragile, but the hatred for Jakub was mutual and immense.
rules_story_para2: As Generals, you must now carry out this massive attack before the sun rises and the moonshine in your warriors' veins stops working.
rules_drama_vampire_desc: A fourth-class aristocrat whose cape remembers the Swedish Deluge. He suffers from chronic anemia, because in Wojsławice even cows have too little hemoglobin. Instead of noble blood, he drinks whatever he manages to squeeze out of expired black pudding.
rules_drama_werewolf_desc: Looks like a wet carpet from the PRL era. His "wolf nature" manifests itself mainly in obsessive scratching behind his ear and panic fear of a thrown slipper. On a full moon, he usually argues with the neighbor's dog on a chain.
rules_drama_ghost_desc: The ghost of a former tractor driver. Instead of ectoplasm, he emits the smell of burnt lignite and cheap cigarettes. He is so un-scary that local mice use him as free air conditioning.
rules_drama_bardak_desc: The patriarch of the clan with skin the color of old bacon. In his sticky beard, he keeps spare gaskets for his moonshine apparatus and half a loaf of bread for a rainy day. His gaze is as cloudy as his best distillate.
rules_drama_jakub_desc: Le talimalo ma le fa'alavelave autu. O se tagata fa'amalama tuai, fa'ate'a, ma fasioti tagata sau'ai. E le fiafia o ia i malo, aemaise lava i latou e solia lana togalaau moonshine. O lona to'i e ma'ai e pei o lona poto.
rules_elements_board: Komiti Fa'atonu: Ose laina 6x6 o itulagi e fai ai le taua.
rules_elements_bands: Undead Hordes: Vampires, Werewolves, Ghosts, ma Bardaks o loʻo tau mo le pule.
rules_elements_sets: Sets (Tactical Assault Units): Single small tactical assault units consisting of members of different bands. Mo le tuʻuina o sea iunite i luga o le laupapa, e maua e taʻitaʻiʻau o vaega taʻitasi ia 'ai manumalo.
rules_elements_jakub: Jakub: O se pawn tulaga ese e faʻaumatia mea uma i lona ala.
rules_elements_panel_jakub: Laupapa a Jakub: Itu laulau mo le puleaina o fuainumera ma le ita o Jakub Wędrowycz.
rules_elements_panel_reinforcements: Vaega Fa'amalosia Fa'aili: Panele fa'ailoa le tapula'a ma le tulaga o pa'u o pa'u ta'itasi i luga o le laupapa.
rules_elements_events: Mea na tutupu: O a'afiaga fa'afuase'i e suia ai tulafono o le ta'aloga i ta'amilosaga uma.
rules_elements_fig2: Ata 2: Fa'amalama o mea na tutupu ma fa'amatalaga o a'afiaga.
rules_elements_fig3: Ata 3: Fa'ata'ita'iga lona lua o se mea na tupu.
rules_flow_intro: O le ta'aloga e 12 ta'amilosaga. O ta'amilosaga ta'itasi e iai vaega e lima:
rules_flow_geometry_neighbor: Tuaoi: Lua vaega e tuaoi le tasi ma le isi pe a tutusa le pito (itu) poʻo se tulimanu tutusa. Vaega e mafai ona maua mai le 3 i le 8 vaega tuaoi.
rules_flow_geometry_dist: Mamao: O le mamao i le va o vaega e fuaina i laasaga. O le si'i atu i so'o se vaega lata ane - tu'u sa'o, fa'alava, po'o le fa'ata'oto - e tasi lava le la'a. O le mamao i le va o vaega e lua o le numera laʻititi o ia laasaga e oʻo mai le tasi i le isi.
rules_flow_geometry_jakub_dist: Mamao mai Jakub: O le mamao e fuaina i laʻasaga i le va o le vaega o loʻo tu ai Jakub ma le vaega faʻatatau o loʻo tuʻuina ai le seti.
rules_flow_geometry_caption: Faataitaiga o mamao. Vampire o loʻo i le itulagi ma Jakub, o le mamao 0. Werewolves i le mamao 1, Ghosts i le mamao 2, Bardaks i le mamao 3.
rules_flow_hierarchy_desc: Fo'ia tulaga tutusa uma i le taaloga. Tulaga sinia o fusi mai le maualuga i lalo:
rules_flow_tie_desc: Afai e lua pe sili atu tagata taaalo e tutusa le numera o 'ai, e le suia la latou faasologa. Afai e maua se fusia mo le manumalo, e malo le tagata taalo e ta'ita'ia le faaili maualuga i le Fa'aupuga Fa'aili.
rules_flow_fury_desc: Le maualuga o le ita o Jakub i se faaili. E leai se tapulaa maualuga. Fa'atusaina e fa'ailoga i luga o le ala i le Laulau a Jakub.
rules_flow_range_desc: O le tele o gaoioiga a Iakupa. O le laina fa'avae o le 1. Afai o le ita o Jakub i so'o se fa'aili e 10 pe sili atu, e fa'atupula'ia le laina i le 1 mo ia fa'aili ta'itasi.
rules_flow_p1_desc: I le amataga o ta'amilosaga ta'itasi, e tusi ai seti e ta'aalo. Afai e gaogao le fa'aputu tusi, e toe sui le fa'aputu lafo ma avea ma fa'aputu tusi fou. E le gata i lea, e maua e Jakub 2 seti faʻafuaseʻi ma faʻafouina lona ita mo le taamilosaga e faʻavae i luga.
rules_flow_p2_desc: I le taamilosaga muamua, e filifilia e le au taaalo se lautele (i le faasologa: Tagata Taaalo 1, Taaalo 2, Taaalo 3). I taamilosaga mulimuli ane, o le tagata taalo e maualalo le numera o 'ai e filifili muamua (ma afai e iai se fusiua, e le suia le faasologa).
rules_flow_p3_desc: E feauauai tagata taaalo i le faasologa faafeagai o togi (muamua togi maualalo). I lo latou taimi, e tatau i le tagata taalo ona tuu se seti i luga o le laupapa (totogi i pawns) pe pasi. O le pasi e muta ai le vaega a le tagata taalo mo le taamilosaga. E maua e le tagata taalo le 2 'ai mo le pasi (ponesi points).
rules_flow_p4_desc: Ua gaoioi Jakupo ma faamama le laupapa. O lenei vaega e otometi atoa.
rules_flow_p5_desc: O se kata fou o mea na tupu ua tusia ma fa'aoga. O mea e tutupu e mafai ona suia tulafono, tapulaʻa, poʻo pawns faʻaola. Pau lava le tuusaunoaga o le faaiʻuga tele - i le taamilosaga mulimuli, nai lo le fofoina o se mea fou, ua maeʻa tauiviga ma faia le sikoa mulimuli!
rules_scoring_intro: O togi manumalo e tu'uina atu i le Herszt o se fa'aili pe a tu'u i luga o le laupapa se seti o lo'o i ai pawns o lena fa'aili. O togi e fa'atatau i le mamao mai Jakub ma le iai o isi pawns:
rules_scoring_vampire_desc: Maka = (4 - mamao ia Jakub) * VampireCount. I le mamao maualuga o le 5, latou te maua -1 mata i le vampire.
rules_scoring_werewolf_desc: 1 togi faavae + 1 togi mo 3 werewolves uma (fa'ata'amilo i lalo) i le taula'iga + itulagi tuaoi. +1 ponesi faaopoopo pe afai o le mamao i Jakub e 0 pe 1.
rules_scoring_ghost_desc: 2 - (mamao i le pito sili ona latalata) ile aitu. Afai o le mamao ia Jakub o lo'o i totonu o lona laina, toese le 1 mata mai le tau o aitu taitasi.
rules_scoring_bardak_desc: 1 'ai mo Bardak. Afai o le mamao ia Jakub e 0 pe 1, latou te mauaina 0 'ai mo Bardak.
rules_scoring_ex1: Fa'ata'ita'iga 1: Vampire tu'u i le mamao 2. Maua fa'avae 1 'ai, leai se ponesi latalata, leai se fa'asalaga. Aofa'i: 1 'ai.
rules_scoring_ex2: Fa'ata'ita'iga 2: Vampire tu'u i le mamao 1. Maua fa'avae 1 'ai, ponesi latalata +1 'ai, ae fa'asala -1 'ai (Ita Jakub > 0). Aofa'i: 1 'ai.
rules_scoring_ex3: Fa'ata'ita'iga 3: Werewolf tu'u i le mamao 1. Maua fa'avae 1 'ai, ponesi latalata +1 'ai, leai se fa'asalaga. Aofa'i: 2 'ai.
rules_scoring_ex4: Fa'ata'ita'iga 4: Ua tu'u le luko i le mamao 1 ma le ato. Maua fa'avae 1 'ai, ponesi latalata +1 'ai, pusa ponesi +1 'ai. Aofa'i: 3 'ai.
rules_scoring_ex5: Fa'ata'ita'iga 5: Ua tu'u le luko fa'atasi ma le ato tele (tele 6). O le pusa ponesi e +2 'ai. Aofa'i: 4 'ai.
rules_scoring_ex6: Faataitaiga 6: Vampire tuu i le mamao 2. mamao e 2, o lea e maua ai le 4 - 2 = 2 togi faavae, leai se faasalaga. Aofa'i: 2 'ai.
rules_jakub_title: O le ita ma le tuliga o Iakupa
rules_jakub_p1_title: Fa'amama i le Vaega o lo'o iai nei:
rules_jakub_p1_desc: Aʻo leʻi alu, Jakub faʻaumatia pawns o vaega ita i lana vaega, ae naʻo le maualuga o lona Ita. Mo pa'u ta'itasi ua fa'aumatia, e 1 'ai e leiloa e le Herszt o lea fa'aili. A mae'a ta'i pa'u ta'itasi, e pa'u ifo le ita o Jakub i lea fa'aili i le 1. O le ita i se fa'aili e le mafai ona pa'u ifo i lalo ole 0.
rules_jakub_p2_desc: Afai o loʻo i ai pea le ita o Jakub ma e leai ni faʻamoemoe i lana vaega, na te agaʻi atu i le maualuga maualuga o le ita. E faalagolago le mamao i le ita. O sootaga e fofoina e ala i le "Band Hierarchy" cascade.
rules_jakub_magnetism_title: ⚡ Maneta Manu e le mafai ona taofia (E le mafai ona e taofia lenei mea)
rules_jakub_magnetism_desc: Afai e i ai se fusia atoatoa i le va o vaega pe a uma ona siaki uma vaega ita, o pawns mai vaega uma e saisai e toso i le vaega a Jakub. E le minoi Iakupo.
rules_jakub_witness_desc: O nei togi e maua mo le lototele o pawns na sao mai se feiloaiga ma Jakub. E lua mataupu e tuuina atu: a'o le'i tuua e Jakub lona itulagi o iai nei (mo pawns ola o se tuuga ma le ita = 0 i lena itulagi) ma i le faaiuga tonu o le vaega a Jakub (mo pawns o totoe i lona itulagi mulimuli). O le Herszt o lea fa'aili e maua le 1 'ai mo le pa'u o lo'o ola.
rules_jakub_mercy_title: Le Vaega o le Alofa Mutimutivale o Iakupa
rules_jakub_p3_desc: I le faaiuga lava o le vaega a Jakub (ina ua uma lana gaioiga), afai e tumau pea se ita i luga o le ala a Jakub agai i se tuuga, o le afa o lena ita (faataamilo i luga) e tufatufa atu e manumalo i le Herszt o loo i ai nei o lena tuuga. O le afa o totoe e tumau i luga o le ala ita a Jakub mo le isi taamilosaga.
rules_jakub_ex1: Fa'amatalaga 1: Ua fasiotia e Jakub se Bardak i lana vaega. Ua pa'ū le ita ile 1.
rules_jakub_ex2: Fa'amatalaga 2: Ua alu Jakub i le vāega ma le tele o Bardaks. Ole laina ole 1.
rules_jakub_ex3: Fa'amatalaga 3: Ua fasiotia e Jakub pawns uma i le vaega.
rules_jakub_ex4: Fa'amatalaga 4: Fa'atonuga fa'asolo. E maualuga atu aitu nai lo Bardaks. Ua siitia Jakub i le vaega o Ghost.
rules_jakub_ex5: Fa'amatalaga 5: Ua fasiotia e Jakub le 2 Ghosts ma le Bardak. Ua muta le tuliga. E ola le Werewolf, maua le 1 'ai.
rules_end_bonus_vampires: Vampires: 2 points mo itulagi taʻitasi e iai Vampires.
rules_end_bonus_werewolves: Werewolves: 1 points mo pawn Werewolf taitasi i luga o le laupapa.
rules_end_bonus_ghosts: Ghosts: 2 points mo itulagi ta'itasi e na'o Ghosts, 1 points pe a Ghosts e to'atele.
rules_end_bonus_bardaks: Bardaks: 1 togi mo itulagi ta'itasi e to'atele ai Bardaks.
rules_end_tie_desc: So'o se feso'ota'iga e fo'ia e le Fa'aili Fa'aili.
rules_faq_a1: Ioe! Afai e te le fiafia i ai, alu ese.
rules_faq_a2: E le o se ta'aloga e maua ai 'ai ae o se ta'aloga e faia'ina ai isi nai lo oe.
rules_faq_q3: E faapefea ona foia sootaga i tulaga eseese?
rules_faq_a3:
• Poloaiga a le Tagata Ta'alo: Afai e tutusa 'ai o le manumalo, e tumau pea le le suia o le faasologa o tagata taaalo.
• Filifiliga Taulai a Jakub: Afai e iai se fusiua i tulaga o le ita, o le filifiliga o le sini e foia fa'apitoa (fa'aoso). I le tulaga o se fusiua atoatoa, Unbridled Animal Magnetism e filifili.
• Fuafuaina o le Manumalo: Afai e maua le tutusa i sikoa mulimuli, o le manumalo o le tagata taalo na te pulea le aoao o le faaili e sili ona maualuga i le Faiga Faaili.
rules_faq_q4: O a ni fuafuaga fautuaina mo tagata taaalo?
rules_faq_a4:
• Aloese mai le avea ma tagata taalo muamua: O le tagata taalo muamua i le taamilosaga e leai sana filifiliga po o le fea faaili latou te pulea.
• Tu'i le ta'ita'i: Pe a mafai, fa'amata'i ia Jakub e uiga i le tagata ta'alo muamua (tagata ta'amua) e fa'avaivaia ai i latou.
• Fuafua au seti i luma: Afai e te faʻamoemoe e pulea se faʻaili patino i le isi taamilosaga, mafaufau e teu seti o lena faʻaili e faʻateleina au togi mulimuli ane.
rules_faq_a5:
I le Igilisi manino:
• Ta'alo Vampires: tu'u seti ma Vampires latalata ia Jakub pe a mafai.
• Ta'alo Werewolves: tu'u i tafatafa o isi Werewolves, e fetaui lelei ma Jakub.
• Ta'alo Aitu: tu'u latalata i pito o le laupapa pe a mafai, mamao mai Iakupa.
• Ta'alo Bardaks: tu'u mamao mai Jakub pe a mafai.
• E i ai seti o isi ituaiga? Aua le tu'uina, na'o le ave i Jakub, o se ta'iala lelei.
• Pe a filifilia se tagata lautele: mafaufau pe fia ni au pa'u i seti o lena tuuga ma le tele o le ita o Jakub ia i latou.
• O se lautele maualuga i le Band Hierarchy e maua atili 'ai.
• O le lautele pito i lalo i le Band Hierarchy e leiloa nisi 'ai.
rules_footer_note: O nei tulafono e fausia ai le faavae o le MASAKRA ma Starym Majdanie simulator logic.

event.16.title: La Leak
event.16.description: Fale e le malu puipuia. Ole tapula'a maualuga ole Vampire ua fa'aitiitia ile 1.
event.17.title: Mailei Hunter
event.17.description: Auvae uamea i le vaomatua. Fa'atapula'a maualuga o Werewolves fa'aitiitia ile 2.
event.18.title: Eleele Malaia
event.18.description: O le fanua lava ia e teena e le oti. Fa'aitiitia le tapula'a a le Werewolf i le 1, Fa'atapula'a a le Agaga i le 2.
event.19.title: Papuipui Paia
event.19.description: O le auai paia e faavaivaia aitu. Ole tapula'a maualuga ole Ghosts ua fa'aitiitia ile 3.
event.20.title: Vaega poloka
event.20.description: O leoleo ma tagata tuliesea o loʻo galulue malosi. Fa'atapula'a mo Ghosts ma Bardaks fa'aitiitia ile 2.
event.21.title: Fa'asalaina Tele
event.21.description: Tavern osofaiga. Fa'aitiitiga maualuga o Bardaks i le 5.
event.22.title: Kilia tulimanu
event.22.description: Ua leoleo e Iakupa le pito i tua. O pa'u uma i tulimanu e 4 o le laupapa e fa'aumatia.
event.23.title: Fa'aliga Laina Totonu
event.23.description: Ua malepe e Jakub le puipuiga i totonu. Pawns i le (1,1), (1,4), (4,1), ma le (4,4) ua aveese.
event.24.title: Tu'u Tu'u Sa'o
event.24.description: Jakub leoleo tuaoi laupapa sa'o. Pawns i pito i luga (e le aofia ai tulimanu) e faʻaumatia.
event.25.title: Fa'asagaga Tupito Fa'asagatau
event.25.description: Ua osofa'i e Jakub tuaoi laupapa faalava. Pawns i pito faalava (e le aofia ai tulimanu) ua aveesea.
event.26.title: Nofoaga Tutotonu
event.26.description: Ua taulai atu e Iakupa lona ita i le fatu o le laupapa. O pawns uma i totonu o le 4 itulagi tutotonu ua faʻaumatia.
event.27.title: Sapalai Pa'u
event.27.description: E auina mai e se tagata agalelei mea lilo. E maua e tagata ta'a'alo ta'itasi se seti fa'aopoopo e 1.
event.28.title: Logistics Mastery
event.28.description: Fa'aleleia laina sapalai. E maua e tagata ta'a'alo ta'itasi 2 seti fa'aopoopo.
event.29.title: Po Filemu
event.29.description: E leai se mea e tupu nanei.
event.30.title: Fa'ailoga Fa'ailoga
event.30.description: O se fa'alavelave fa'apitonu'u e sifi. Tu'u uma pawns mai le (0,0) i le (2,2).
event.31.title: Fa'alavelave Fa'afuase'i
event.31.description: Sola ese mai tuaoi. Ave uma pawns mai le (5,5) i le (3,3).
event.32.title: Afā
event.32.description: Ua agi mai se matagi uiga ese. Ave uma pawns mai le (0,5) i le (1,4).
event.33.title: Totogi!
event.33.description: O pawn uma i luga o vaega tuaoi e tauina le 1 vaega e latalata i le ogatotonu.
event.34.title: Malosiaga Malosi
event.34.description: Pawns i le mamao 1 o Jakub ua tulei ese. Pawns i le ogatotonu e le minoi. Pawns tulei ese le laupapa mate (-1 pt i le General).
event.35.title: Bardak Mata'ai
event.35.description: Ua sola ese Bardaks tuulafoaiina. Ave i latou i vaega tuaoi e sili ona maualuga le numera o isi pawns. I le tulaga o se fusiua (V-> W-> G) pe leai ni tuaoi, latou te o ese mai le laupapa (-1 pt i le General).
event.36.title: Le Kalave a Iakupa
event.36.description: O pawn uma i le mamao 3 pe sili atu mai Jakub e tosoina 1 vaega e latalata atu ia te ia.
event.37.title: Crimson Convergence
event.37.description: O Vampire uma i luga o le laupapa e malaga saʻo i le vaega o loʻo i ai Jakub.
event.38.title: Valaau a Alefa
event.38.description: Lonesome Werewolves e tosoina 1 vaega e latalata i le Werewolf pack sili ona tele.
event.39.title: Fa'asologa o le masina
event.39.description: Lonesome Werewolves e tosoina 1 vaega e latalata i le pusa Werewolf lata ane.
event.40.title: Uu Vampire
event.40.description: I soo se vaega e iai le Vampire e tasi ma le Bardak e tasi, e utia e le Vampire le Bardak, ma suia ai o ia. Afai e tupu se suiga, o le ita o Jakub ia Bardaks e pa'ū i le 0.
event.41.title: Fa'ama'i (Laula)
event.41.description: Su'e le laina ma le tele o Werewolves ma le itiiti ifo i le 1 Bardak. Werewolves fa'ama'i e o'o atu i le tele o Bardaks e pei o latou faitau; o totoe o Bardaks ua sosola i Iakupa. Ua toe tufatufaina atu Werewolves. Afai e leai se fetaui, o le ita o Jakub ia Werewolves e pa'ū i le 0, ma luga o Bardaks e faʻateleina i le 5.
event.42.title: Fa'ama'i Fa'amau (Koluma)
event.42.description: Su'e le koluma e iai le tele o Werewolves ma le itiiti ifo i le 1 Bardak. Werewolves fa'ama'i e o'o atu i le tele o Bardaks e pei o latou faitau; o totoe o Bardaks ua sosola i Iakupa. Ua toe tufatufaina atu Werewolves. Afai e leai se fetaui, o le ita o Jakub ia Werewolves e pa'ū i le 0, ma luga o Bardaks e faʻateleina i le 5.
event.43.title: Tuu le Agaga
event.43.description: Su'esu'e mo so'o se vaega tuaoi o lo'o nofoia e Bardaks. O se tasi o na Bardaks ua liua i se Agaga. O lenei mea e faʻaitiitia ai le numera o Bardaks ma faʻateleina Ghosts. Afai e tupu se suiga, o le ita ia Bardaks e pa'ū i le 0, a leai e faʻateleina i le 5.
